scope: Local final published trajectories only; no confirmation access or new experiments

metric_definitions.training_ce: Recorded changing-batch objective over retained assistant tokens (including answer wrapper); excludes separately added no-context penalty. Not answer-only NLL.
metric_definitions.learning_answer_nll: Mean per-question answer-token NLL on fixed32 training questions for that stage; panels differ across stages, same between the two10k arms.
metric_definitions.held_answer_nll: Mean per-question answer-token NLL on fixed400 development questions, same across stages.
metric_definitions.gradient_norm: Recorded joint AC+reader L2 norm before shared threshold1 clipping; gradient includes main objective and selected no-context penalty.
metric_definitions.clip_fraction: Computed fraction of finite recorded pre-clip norms exceeding configured max_grad_norm; not a separately logged clip-fraction metric.
metric_definitions.group_share: Optional derived squared-norm share from preclip group norms; not parameter movement, Adam update size or a causal attribution.

continue32k_10k_rewarm.resume_caveat: Latest published report combines retained checkpoint prefix with resumed suffix; duplicate question coordinates would be resolved to last occurrence. Discarded work excluded. Separate group traces only latest attempt.

missing_measurements: Per-objective main-versus-penalty gradient decomposition or alignment
Full rewarm separate AC/reader norm trace before+2000 questions

comparability.learn32_identity_evidence: Both10k arms use same pinned material design; initial32 NLL exactly equal. Original32k and subsequentfresh8k have different learning32 panels.
